context: Evaluates correct implementation of the multi-asset pricing API endpoint from open-nof1.ai. The solution must call the market state fetch function for all 5 supported cryptocurrency symbols in parallel using Promise.all, and return the results in the expected nested JSON structure with success flag.

checklist.name: All 5 symbols fetched
checklist.description: The solution fetches market state for all 5 supported perpetual futures pairs: BTC/USDT:USDT, ETH/USDT:USDT, SOL/USDT:USDT, DOGE/USDT:USDT, and BNB/USDT:USDT using the getCurrentMarketState function

checklist.name: Parallel execution
checklist.description: All 5 market state requests are made concurrently using Promise.all rather than sequentially awaiting each one

checklist.name: Response structure
checklist.description: The response JSON has the correct structure: { data: { pricing: { btc, eth, sol, doge, bnb } }, success: true }

checklist.name: Symbol key names
checklist.description: The pricing object keys are lowercase symbol names (btc, eth, sol, doge, bnb) mapping to their respective MarketState objects
